site.description: KDS Offshore designs vessels, offshore structures, and energy systems, with a focus on maritime decarbonisation and digitalisation. Naval architecture, offshore engineering, hydrodynamics, mooring, and digital-twin consultancy from Lisbon, Portugal.
site.slogan: Naval architecture and offshore engineering for decarbonisation and digitalisation.

hero.eyebrow: Naval architecture / offshore engineering / decarbonisation & digitalisation / Lisbon
hero.lede: KDS Offshore designs vessels, offshore structures, and energy systems, with a focus on maritime decarbonisation and digitalisation, from a studio in Lisbon to projects across the Atlantic.

items.d: Production-grade CAD geometry for structural, hydrodynamic and visualisation downstream. Watertight surfaces ready for class-society review.
From small craft to major offshore installations. Stability, structural and intact/damage analysis to international standards.
CFD-driven hull, appendage and propulsor refinement, reducing fuel burn and emissions in real operating conditions.
Time-domain simulation and dynamic models to forecast vessel behaviour and assess autonomous-manoeuvring envelopes inside ports.
Catenary, taut-leg and hybrid systems for floating renewables, aquaculture and offshore platforms. Environmental loads to anchor sizing.
Remotorisation, repurposing and capacity uplift, from minor modifications to full conversions, in compliance with current regulations.
Independent oversight of yards and contractors. Quality control, technical compliance and acceptance testing through delivery.
GHG-reduction pathways for vessels and offshore assets. Alternative fuels, energy efficiency, and FuelEU Maritime / IMO 2050 compliance.
Digital-twin development, data-driven performance monitoring, and digitalisation strategy for fleets and offshore operations.

testimonials.q: KDS Offshore executed the engineering project for the remotorisation and increased capacity of our "Belize I" catamaran with competence, professionalism, and dedication, successfully meeting all established deadlines. We were very impressed with the technical lead, Eng. Sérgio Ribeiro e Silva.

The experience and ship-design numerical tools provided by KDS Offshore to OneOcean during preliminary design and construction of our working boat was much appreciated. Your CFD expertise helped us complete the work and allowed us to comply with the schedule of ship-design activities.

KDS Offshore was responsible for the naval engineering project to convert our motor-sailer "Libries" for scientific tourism, and they executed the work with great competence, professionalism, and dedication, completed within the established deadlines.

The hard work and vast experience provided by KDS Offshore to FUTURE Proman during the Green Ports Madeira study was much appreciated. Your consultancy in renewables and engineering solutions for decarbonisation of the maritime transport sector worked well.

The hard work and enthusiasm provided by KDS Offshore to SeaPower during the pilot-boat project was much appreciated. Your roll-stabilisation and trim-optimisation solutions are expected to work tremendously well and will help us promote energy efficiency and decarbonisation.

services.lede: We work on a curated set of problems we know well: 3D modelling, naval architecture, hydrodynamics, manoeuvrability, mooring, vessel conversion, and the supervision of new constructions, with decarbonisation consultancy threaded through all of it.

steps.d: A 30-minute call to understand the vessel, the operator, and the constraint that triggered the project. We tell you up-front whether we are the right firm.
A fixed-fee, fixed-scope proposal with named principals, deliverables, classification path, and risks. No ambiguity. Within five working days.
Weekly working sessions with the operator. CFD runs, structural FEA, stability books, and class-society liaison delivered against a published Gantt.
Final report, documented model, and 90 days of post-handover support included. Most clients return for the next vessel.

about.lede: KDS Offshore was founded in 2016 by naval architects from Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon. We are a partnership (not a consultancy chain) and we have stayed deliberately small so that the principals are the ones doing the engineering you pay for.

story.d: Pre-incorporation engagement on the GRS Power Platform: parametric rolling and intact stability of a hybrid wind+wave OWC concept, intended for deployment at Belmullet (Ireland).
Incorporated in Lisbon by naval architects from Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon.
CFD support during preliminary design and construction of OneOcean's working boat. Schedule of ship-design activities met.
Naval engineering for the conversion of the motor-sailer "Libries" for Blue Geo Lighthouse. Project completed within the established deadlines.
Remotorisation and capacity uplift of the "Belize I" catamaran for Nautiber. In parallel, OPS design and APRAM fleet retrofitting alongside Future Proman.
Probabilistic manoeuvrability and operability assessment of the 610 TEU container ship "Corvo" inside the harbour of Vila do Porto, for Mutualista / Grupo Bensaúde.

principles.t: No work we cannot stand behind
principles.d: If the brief is wrong, we say so. If the budget is too small, we say so. If a competitor is better placed, we say so. The reputation we are building is worth more than any single fee.
You hire us, you get us. Junior engineers support, but the model, the report, and the recommendation come from a named principal.
Every assumption, every input, every result is documented. Six months later, when the operator has a new question, we can answer it because the model is still alive.
Wherever there is a choice between a faster hull and a cleaner hull, we present both. We believe the maritime sector is going to decarbonise.

cases.lede: We do not publish the full archive, most engagements are confidential. Below is a curated selection that our clients have agreed to make public. References on request.

items.t: "Corvo" autonomous manoeuvring assessment, Vila do Porto
items.detail: Probabilistic study of how often per year the container ship "Corvo" (IMO 9381275) can manoeuvre autonomously inside the harbour basin of Vila do Porto without tug assistance. MatLab-based numerical model coupling hull, rudder with flap, and bow thrusters.

items.t: GRS Power Platform, parametric rolling assessment
items.detail: Pre-deployment de-risking of a bottom-fixed hybrid wind and wave energy concept (six Oscillating Water Columns). Diffraction-radiation in WAMIT and non-linear time-domain simulation in Ship@Sea.

items.t: Green Ports Madeira / APRAM OPS design
items.detail: Engineering solutions for decarbonisation of the maritime transport sector: shore-side power (cold-ironing) design and retrofitting of the APRAM port-authority fleet.
Naval engineering project for remotorisation and increased passenger capacity of the "Belize I" catamaran. Technical lead: Eng. Sérgio Ribeiro e Silva.
Conversion of the motor-sailer "Libries" for scientific tourism operations. Full naval engineering package delivered under technical supervision.
CFD support during preliminary design and construction of OneOcean's working boat. Numerical tools provided by KDS allowed the client to comply with the ship-design programme on schedule.
Roll-stabilisation and trim-optimisation programme for SeaPower's pilot boat. CFD-driven hydrodynamic refinement intended to promote energy efficiency and decarbonisation in port operations.
